VI.description: Closes a VI's front panel in THIS application instance - the one lvai_run_vi_and_read_values runs its target in - when the panel is open, and reports whether it was.\0A\0AWHY IT EXISTS. A program that opens its OWN panel (FP.Open on an unwired {LV.VI} reference - the Web Browser control needs it for Execute JavaScript) leaves that panel open after a run, which keeps the VI in memory, and the next ConvertAIXMLToVI onto its path answers Error 1357. Measured 2026-10-02 by an agent build that could not regenerate its scaffold until it closed the panel itself. Opened WITHOUT an application instance on purpose, because that is where the run happened; a panel open in the IDE instance is not seen here and is left alone.

FreeLabel.comment: Closes the panel only when it is open
